title: From Gift to General Ledger: Bringing Reconciliation into One Connected Workflow
summary: Blackbaud is connecting workflows so information moves with less manual intervention and finance teams have more time for the work that requires their expertise.
body_markdown:
Finance teams should not have to manually reconstruct a financial transaction when the systems involved already have the data.


Deposit Connect™ brings gift reconciliation into a connected workflow across Blackbaud Raiser’s Edge NXT®, Blackbaud Integrated Payments and Blackbaud Financial Edge NXT®, automatically bringing together the gift, fee and disbursement information finance teams need to reconcile deposits to the general ledger.


We’re connecting workflows so information moves with less manual intervention and finance teams have more time for the work that requires their expertise.


Deposit Connect brings gift, fee and disbursement information together in Financial Edge NXT to support a more connected reconciliation workflow.


#####


##### Let the Systems Do the Matching


Deposit Connect automatically ingests and aligns data from Raiser’s Edge NXT, Integrated Payments and Financial Edge NXT. It uses shared transaction identifiers to match activity and creates deposit records after payment disbursements are confirmed. Instead of pulling reports from multiple systems and rebuilding the transaction in a spreadsheet, finance teams can manage reconciliation within their accounting system.


That connection matters because each part of the organization needs a different view of the same transaction. Fundraising needs an accurate gift record. Payments needs to process and disburse the transaction. Finance needs the gross gift, processing fees and net amount received in order to reconcile the activity accurately.


Historically, bringing those pieces together could mean pulling information from multiple systems, matching identifiers and re-entering data. At scale, particularly during periods with hundreds of transactions, that creates unnecessary work and more opportunity for discrepancies.


Deposit Connect lets the technology take on more of that work.


*See how Deposit Connect connects gift, payment and accounting data to streamline reconciliation in Financial Edge NXT.*


[https://www.blackbaud.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/FENXT-Deposit-Connect-Consensus.mp4](https://www.blackbaud.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/FENXT-Deposit-Connect-Consensus.mp4)


#####


##### Faster Reconciliation, Stronger Controls


The value of that automation shows up in several places:


- **Less manual effort.** Automated data ingestion, matching and deposit creation reduce spreadsheet-driven reconciliation and re-entry.


- **Better accuracy and traceability.** System-generated transactions reduce manual reconciliation gaps and provide clearer audit trails.


- **A faster path to close.** Automated grouping, matching and posting of cash activity reduces reconciliation work that can contribute to month-end bottlenecks.


- **Better visibility into cash activity.** Finance teams can see deposit and disbursement information in Financial Edge NXT without having to reconstruct that view across multiple systems.


That is a meaningful operational change. It moves reconciliation away from a process held together by spreadsheets and manual handoffs and toward one managed within the financial system itself.


##### Connection Creates the Foundation for What Comes Next


Deposit Connect is also part of something larger.


At bbcon 2026, we introduced Platform for Good, Blackbaud’s unified operating system designed to bring social impact workflows together through shared data, intelligence and action. Its Action Layer is where AI-powered assistants, agents and workflows can help organizations move from information to execution with appropriate human oversight and control.


For finance, that direction starts with connected workflows and trustworthy context.


AI becomes considerably more useful when the systems behind it understand how work moves through an organization. Connecting fundraising, payments and accounting gives us a stronger foundation for intelligent financial workflows because the system has more context about the activity it is helping finance teams manage.


Deposit Connect itself is about workflow automation, not an AI feature. But it demonstrates an important part of our strategy: connect the underlying work first, then build greater intelligence and automation on top of that connected foundation.


Deposit Connect connects the path from gift to payment to deposit to general ledger.


##### More Time for Financial Stewardship


Ultimately, that is the outcome we’re working toward across Financial Edge NXT.


Finance professionals should spend their time applying judgment, strengthening controls, understanding their organization’s financial position and helping leaders make good decisions. Technology should take on more of the repetitive work required to get reliable information in front of them.


Deposit Connect moves us another step in that direction by connecting the path from gift to payment to deposit to general ledger.


Less manual assembly. Better-connected data. More capacity for financial stewardship.
